items.html: And these eleven spices of the incense are but one, which is the Noga [brightness] round about it; and corresponding to it likewise in Yetzira, and so in Beria, and so in Atzilut. And this shell of Noga is called “the spirit of Elokim hovering” [Merachefet], whose letters are Met Parach [“died, flew away”] — they are the 288 sparks of the kings who died. And this shell was made from the 288 sparks that remained inside the vessels and were not sorted, and it hovers over the shells and did not enter into them.
